posts.author: Holder
posts.body:
Thank you all very much for that.
I was originally thinking about doing a generator parts sort of set up but with the way things can overlap tends to throw problems into the graphic.
However I've been trying to get NPCs done with parts and bits from the actor map sprites I'm also making, so far it's almost at 100 images. Though that number is kind of around 25 since I'm still doing the four different kinds of skin tones to help mix up the variation for map visuals.
Still wondering how's best to distribute these separate map sprites. The actor ones are going into a pack with the battlers and portraits. Should I do a themed NPC pack? Since these currently are all focused around a castle town theme.

posts.author: LunarFlareStudios
posts.body: I'd enjoy a few themed packs. Are you making parts for these too? Like hair and wings? When I use base parts to make non-RTP sprites, I usually like to use parts that are all from the same artist. If you're not going to make any though, that's absolutely fine. Either way, I'd love to see more!
